fusions.name: Who Struck Whom
fusions.desc: You dart up to 5 tiles into the pack, deal 8 damage to up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles, and turn them against each other for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pocketed Finish
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Doubled Back
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Feint and Fleece
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you deal 7% more damage per stack (20% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
